text: dsh-markdown-input 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Markdown 输入插件。它在会话输入区注册低优先级编辑器入口，以 CodeMirror 6 提供边写边渲染的编辑体验，并支持切换源码模式；内置审批、提问等输入面板仍保持优先。插件还将已发送和排队中的用户消息按 Markdown 显示，并把剪贴板富文本转换成 Markdown。适合希望在 DSH 中组织 Markdown 提示词、保留消息换行或粘贴网页格式内容的用户。安装命令为 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markdown-input`，无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-markdown-input adds live Markdown editing, source mode, rendered user messages, and rich-text paste conversion to the DSH web composer. It suits people who organize prompts in Markdown. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markdown-input`; no API key is required.
想在 DSH 输入提示词时直接看到 Markdown 排版。
能不能让聊天输入框支持 Markdown 源码和预览切换？
我希望已发送的用户消息也能按 Markdown 显示。
从网页复制格式化文字后，怎么粘贴成干净的 Markdown？
Can I preview Markdown while composing a prompt in DSH?
How can I turn formatted text copied from a webpage into Markdown when pasting?
dsh-markdown-input 的功能「Markdown 输入与预览」：会话输入区提供 CodeMirror Markdown 编辑器，可切换渲染和源码模式。输入内容同步到宿主草稿，刷新页面后可继续使用。
dsh-markdown-input 的功能「消息 Markdown 渲染」：发送后的用户消息和排队中的 steering 消息以 Markdown 气泡呈现，保留文本换行并继续显示附件内容。消息在聊天记录中出现时自动渲染。
dsh-markdown-input 的功能「富文本转 Markdown」：在编辑器中粘贴网页或文档的富文本时，将 HTML 转为 Markdown 并插入光标位置；文件和图片仍交给宿主附件处理，纯文本粘贴保留原行为。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin with one core capability — **live Markdown rendering in the composer** — so that prompts written in dsh are easier to organize and easier to think through.

dsh-markdown-input README · dsh-markdown-input：> **Status: alpha, under active development.** dsh itself is a developer preview with compatibility-breaking changes between versions — see [Compatibility](#compatibility) for what has actually been verified on a real machine.

dsh-markdown-input README · Live-rendering composer：A low-priority entry on the host's `conversation.composer` election chain ([ADR-0005](docs/adr/0005-composer-revival.md)) takes the composer over with a bundled CodeMirror 6 editor that renders while you type, Obsidian Live Preview style: bold, italic, inline code and strikethrough take their real styles, and syntax markers fold away once the cursor leaves their line. A toggle switches to source mode, where every marker stays visible. Enter sends (IME-safe), `Shift+Enter` breaks the line, and everything you type mirrors into the host draft, so it survives a page reload.

dsh-markdown-input README · Markdown-rendered user messages：Sent user messages and queued steering messages render as Markdown in the chat history — reusing the host's own rendering pipeline — instead of a wall of plain text. `@`-mentions and skill chips are preserved, and the line breaks you typed are rendered as hard breaks.

dsh-markdown-input README · Paste-to-Markdown：Pasting rich text from a web page or a word processor converts the clipboard's `text/html` into clean Markdown — in the takeover editor at the caret, and on the native composer through the host's version-guarded insertion API. `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V` still pastes plain text, and plain-text, file and image pastes keep their native behavior.

dsh-markdown-input README · Graceful degradation, face by face：Every surface probes the host before it activates and degrades on its own: built-in takeover panels (approvals, questions, subagents) outrank this plugin and keep the composer whenever they need it; a missing host surface sheds its own feature, never the text face; and a card-level error boundary silently falls back to the native composer with the draft intact.

dsh-markdown-input README · Install：Requires dsh with the web UI (the desktop app). The build and automated suite currently target dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`; the last **on-device** verification is `0.2.0-rc.2` — see the [compatibility matrix](#compatibility) before installing.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markdown-input
dsh plugin --profile web add github:long6177/dsh-markdown-input
```

dsh-markdown-input README · Compatibility：This project makes no range claims. What it has instead is a tested matrix — combinations actually run on a real machine, with dates and outcomes — and a standing watch on upstream drift.

dsh-markdown-input README · Compatibility：| dsh version | Plugin versions verified | Last on-device verification | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | `0.2.0-alpha.0` → `0.2.0-alpha.20`, `0.2.2` → `0.2.3` | 2026-10-25 | Passed |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | — | — | **Not verified on device** (automated suite passed 2026-10-24) |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` | — | — | **Not verified** |

dsh-markdown-input README · Compatibility：- Every npm release so far — `0.2.0-alpha.0` (2026-10-02) through `0.2.0-alpha.20` (2026-10-07), then `0.2.2` and `0.2.3` (2026-10-25) — was re-tested on the official desktop client running the `0.2.0-rc.2` kernel (the current public desktop build still bundles that kernel). Each release ships an acceptance checklist; the per-version index with dates lives in [docs/release/README.md](docs/release/README.md). `0.2.1` and the `0.2.2`→`0.2.3` hotfix cycle were covered by the same-day `0.2.3` retest.
- The dependency pins now target upstream `0.2.1-rc.2`: the dev-dependency lockstep and CI stay on it (see [package.json](package.json)), and the full automated suite (typecheck, build, published and fidelity test faces) passes against it as of 2026-10-24. The peer range is widened to `^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2` — both kernels are verified on device (the current public desktop bundles `0.2.0-rc.2`, where `0.2.2`/`0.2.3` passed on 2026-10-25; the union is required because semver only matches prereleases against comparators sharing their `[major, minor, patch]` tuple). Drift watch (below) keeps tracking whatever upstream ships next.
- **Drift watch.

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）插件。为了让用户在使用 dsh 输入提示词时能更清晰地组织语言与思路，我们提供以**输入区 Markdown 实时渲染**为核心的能力——敲下的就是发出去的，看到的也是敲下的。

> **状态：alpha，积极开发中。** dsh 本身处于 developer preview，版本之间存在破坏性变更——哪些组合真正在真机上验证过，见[兼容性](#兼容性)。

dsh-markdown-input README · 输入区实时渲染：经宿主 `conversation.composer` 选举链的低优先级条目（[ADR-0005](docs/adr/0005-composer-revival.md)），输入区由自带的 CodeMirror 6 编辑器接管，Obsidian Live Preview 式：粗体、斜体、行内代码、删除线以真样式呈现，语法标记在光标离开所在行后折叠隐去；一键切换源码模式，所有标记保持原文可见。Enter 发送（中文 IME 安全）、`Shift+Enter` 换行，输入内容实时镜像进宿主草稿，页面刷新不丢。
dsh-markdown-input README · 用户消息 Markdown 化：已发送的用户消息与排队中的 steering 消息在聊天记录里按 Markdown 渲染——复用宿主自带的渲染管线——而不是一整面纯文本。`@` 提及与技能引用 chip 原样保留，你敲下的换行按硬换行保真呈现。
dsh-markdown-input README · 粘贴转 Markdown：从网页或文字处理软件粘贴富文本时，剪贴板的 `text/html` 自动转为干净的 Markdown——接管卡内落在光标处，原生输入区经宿主带版本守卫的插入 API 一步写入。`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V` 仍直插纯文本，纯文本、文件与图片粘贴的行为不变。
dsh-markdown-input README · 逐面降级：每个面激活前先探测宿主能力，失败即独立降级：内置接管面板（审批、提问、子代理）优先级更高，需要输入区时照常抢占；宿主面缺失时只失去对应功能，文本面永不下线；卡级 error boundary 在渲染异常时静默回落原生输入区，草稿不丢。

dsh-markdown-input README · 安装：前提：装有 Web UI 的 dsh（官方桌面端）。当前构建与自动化套件对准 dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`；最近一次**真机**验证是 `0.2.0-rc.2`——装在更新的 dsh 上之前，先看[兼容性矩阵](#兼容性)。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markdown-input
dsh plugin --profile web add github:long6177/dsh-markdown-input
```

| `0.2.0-rc.2` | `0.2.0-alpha.0` → `0.2.0-alpha.20`、`0.2.2` → `0.2.3` | 2026-10-25 | 通过 |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | — | — | **真机未验证**（自动化套件 2026-10-24 通过） |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` | — | — | **未验证** |

dsh-markdown-input README · 兼容性：- 迄今每一次 npm 发布——`0.2.0-alpha.0`（2026-10-02）到 `0.2.0-alpha.20`（2026-10-07），以及 `0.2.2`、`0.2.3`（2026-10-25）——都在运行 `0.2.0-rc.2` 内核的官方桌面端上重测过（桌面公开版当前捆绑的仍是该内核）。每次发布附带一份验收清单，逐版本索引与日期见 [docs/release/README.md](docs/release/README.md)。`0.2.1` 与 `0.2.2`→`0.2.3` 热修复环由同日 `0.2.3` 的重测覆盖。
- 依赖 pin 仍锁步上游 `0.2.1-rc.2`：devDependencies 与 CI 不动（见 [package.json](package.json)），全套自动化套件（typecheck、build、发布包与保真两个测试面）已于 2026-10-24 对它跑绿。peer range 放宽为 `^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2`——两个内核均已真机验证（桌面公开版当前捆绑 `0.2.0-rc.2`，`0.2.2`/`0.2.3` 已于 2026-10-25 在其上通过；取并集是因为 semver 的 prerelease 只与同 `[major, minor, patch]` 元组的比较子匹配）。漂移监视（见下）继续跟踪上游后续版本。
- **漂移监视。** 一个定时仓库工作流每天探测四路上游信号：npm registry（新版本与 dist-tag）、上游 Release 与 Tag、本插件所依赖契约路径上的提交、官方契约文档的提交。命中新版本即以该版本跑全套测试与 semver 检查，并按版本开一张跟踪 issue（标签 `upstream-drift`）。工作流只负责开 issue——不改代码，也不自行宣布兼容。

dsh-markdown-input README · 设计说明：这里是四行摘要，深文在 [docs/design/](docs/design/)：

- [为什么是接管](docs/design/why-takeover.md) —— 输入区路线的工程叙事（绘制层 → 接管 → 复活），以及当前扩展模型下的四条精确缺口，每条都有上游源码位置背书。
- [扩展点调研](docs/design/extension-points.md) —— dsh Web UI 允许插件触碰什么的源码级底册：槽位、composer 选举链、消息渲染器。
- [原生面重建规格](docs/design/native-surfaces-rebuild.md) —— 接管后需要自绘的工具行弹层逐件规格（命令菜单、权限预设、模型选择）。
- [主流产品对照](docs/design/prior-art.md) —— 主流聊天产品输入区对 Markdown 的处理行为，全部取材一手来源。

决策记录（编辑器选型、接管、发布仪式、开发依赖模型）在 [docs/adr/](docs/adr/)。

dsh-markdown-input README · 设计说明：**上游愿望清单。** 上述缺口对应五条具体的接口期望——视图层复用、原生座位在接管下幸存、正式接管契约与一致性套件、插件脚手架、preview 期的稳定性或弃用策略。成文在 [docs/design/why-takeover.md · 上游愿望清单](docs/design/why-takeover.md#上游愿望清单)，将作为 Discussions 的「Ideas」帖发布，供社区按 upvote 表达优先级。

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）插件。为了让用户在使用 dsh 输入提示词时能更清晰地组织语言与思路，我们提供以**输入区 Markdown 实时渲染**为核心的能力——敲下的就是发出去的，看到的也是敲下的。

dsh-markdown-input README · 输入区实时渲染：经宿主 `conversation.composer` 选举链的低优先级条目（[ADR-0005](docs/adr/0005-composer-revival.md)），输入区由自带的 CodeMirror 6 编辑器接管，Obsidian Live Preview 式：粗体、斜体、行内代码、删除线以真样式呈现，语法标记在光标离开所在行后折叠隐去；一键切换源码模式，所有标记保持原文可见。Enter 发送（中文 IME 安全）、`Shift+Enter` 换行，输入内容实时镜像进宿主草稿，页面刷新不丢。
dsh-markdown-input README · 用户消息 Markdown 化：已发送的用户消息与排队中的 steering 消息在聊天记录里按 Markdown 渲染——复用宿主自带的渲染管线——而不是一整面纯文本。`@` 提及与技能引用 chip 原样保留，你敲下的换行按硬换行保真呈现。
dsh-markdown-input README · 粘贴转 Markdown：从网页或文字处理软件粘贴富文本时，剪贴板的 `text/html` 自动转为干净的 Markdown——接管卡内落在光标处，原生输入区经宿主带版本守卫的插入 API 一步写入。`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V` 仍直插纯文本，纯文本、文件与图片粘贴的行为不变。
dsh-markdown-input README · 逐面降级：每个面激活前先探测宿主能力，失败即独立降级：内置接管面板（审批、提问、子代理）优先级更高，需要输入区时照常抢占；宿主面缺失时只失去对应功能，文本面永不下线；卡级 error boundary 在渲染异常时静默回落原生输入区，草稿不丢。

dsh-markdown-input README · 安装：前提：装有 Web UI 的 dsh（官方桌面端）。当前构建与自动化套件对准 dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`；最近一次**真机**验证是 `0.2.0-rc.2`——装在更新的 dsh 上之前，先看[兼容性矩阵](#兼容性)。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markdown-input
dsh plugin --profile web add github:long6177/dsh-markdown-input
```

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin with one core capability — **live Markdown rendering in the composer** — so that prompts written in dsh are easier to organize and easier to think through.

dsh-markdown-input README · dsh-markdown-input：> **Status: alpha, under active development.** dsh itself is a developer preview with compatibility-breaking changes between versions — see [Compatibility](#compatibility) for what has actually been verified on a real machine.

dsh-markdown-input README · Live-rendering composer：A low-priority entry on the host's `conversation.composer` election chain ([ADR-0005](docs/adr/0005-composer-revival.md)) takes the composer over with a bundled CodeMirror 6 editor that renders while you type, Obsidian Live Preview style: bold, italic, inline code and strikethrough take their real styles, and syntax markers fold away once the cursor leaves their line. A toggle switches to source mode, where every marker stays visible. Enter sends (IME-safe), `Shift+Enter` breaks the line, and everything you type mirrors into the host draft, so it survives a page reload.

dsh-markdown-input README · Markdown-rendered user messages：Sent user messages and queued steering messages render as Markdown in the chat history — reusing the host's own rendering pipeline — instead of a wall of plain text. `@`-mentions and skill chips are preserved, and the line breaks you typed are rendered as hard breaks.

dsh-markdown-input README · Paste-to-Markdown：Pasting rich text from a web page or a word processor converts the clipboard's `text/html` into clean Markdown — in the takeover editor at the caret, and on the native composer through the host's version-guarded insertion API. `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V` still pastes plain text, and plain-text, file and image pastes keep their native behavior.

dsh-markdown-input README · Graceful degradation, face by face：Every surface probes the host before it activates and degrades on its own: built-in takeover panels (approvals, questions, subagents) outrank this plugin and keep the composer whenever they need it; a missing host surface sheds its own feature, never the text face; and a card-level error boundary silently falls back to the native composer with the draft intact.

dsh-markdown-input README · Install：Requires dsh with the web UI (the desktop app). The build and automated suite currently target dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`; the last **on-device** verification is `0.2.0-rc.2` — see the [compatibility matrix](#compatibility) before installing.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markdown-input
dsh plugin --profile web add github:long6177/dsh-markdown-input
```

dsh-markdown-input README · Compatibility：This project makes no range claims. What it has instead is a tested matrix — combinations actually run on a real machine, with dates and outcomes — and a standing watch on upstream drift.

dsh-markdown-input README · Compatibility：| dsh version | Plugin versions verified | Last on-device verification | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | `0.2.0-alpha.0` → `0.2.0-alpha.20`, `0.2.2` → `0.2.3` | 2026-10-25 | Passed |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | — | — | **Not verified on device** (automated suite passed 2026-10-24) |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` | — | — | **Not verified** |

dsh-markdown-input README · Compatibility：- Every npm release so far — `0.2.0-alpha.0` (2026-10-02) through `0.2.0-alpha.20` (2026-10-07), then `0.2.2` and `0.2.3` (2026-10-25) — was re-tested on the official desktop client running the `0.2.0-rc.2` kernel (the current public desktop build still bundles that kernel). Each release ships an acceptance checklist; the per-version index with dates lives in [docs/release/README.md](docs/release/README.md). `0.2.1` and the `0.2.2`→`0.2.3` hotfix cycle were covered by the same-day `0.2.3` retest.
- The dependency pins now target upstream `0.2.1-rc.2`: the dev-dependency lockstep and CI stay on it (see [package.json](package.json)), and the full automated suite (typecheck, build, published and fidelity test faces) passes against it as of 2026-10-24. The peer range is widened to `^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2` — both kernels are verified on device (the current public desktop bundles `0.2.0-rc.2`, where `0.2.2`/`0.2.3` passed on 2026-10-25; the union is required because semver only matches prereleases against comparators sharing their `[major, minor, patch]` tuple). Drift watch (below) keeps tracking whatever upstream ships next.
- **Drift watch.
